reasons.text: Buys feedstock inside a closed loop of 5 recyclers trading the same material (8% of its feedstock)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 17% of months
First-digit pattern of invoice quantities departs from Benford's law (MAD 0.094)
28% of all certificates were generated in a single month
Company was only 156 days old when it registered under EPR

inspection_checklist: Trace the material flow between the plants in the loop (weighbridge slips, vehicle GPS); the same tonnes may be invoiced round a ring.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Review the invoice quantity distribution; digit patterns can indicate fabricated figures.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Check the company's incorporation and registration history and the source of its capital.
